posts.title: book: Semiosis , Sue Burke
posts.description: as a speculative bio enjoyer, it did take me a bit to get in-tune with Semiosis . I kept distracting myself with questions about why an alien planet would have plants and animals very much within a reasonable Earthen frame (like the fippokats). I had to get over myself.
